summary: Locked, Nix-resolved dependencies for Alire and Ada.

values.quickstart:
nix shell 'github:nix-purifiers/alire-purifier'
alire-purifier lock
alr build
alr run
values.language_tooling_setup: GNAT and GPR-based tooling reads the prepared dependency projects and their readonly Nix library paths. Start the editor process with `alire-purifier exec -- your-editor` so it receives the same native project environment as `alr build`. This integration supplies GPR metadata and the GNAT/GPR toolchain; it does not supply a separate LSP launcher.
